title: panvram: a pangenome cohort resident on the GPU as refrel3 archives against one reference
description: PyTorch extension that keeps a cohort of genome assemblies resident on the GPU (or CPU) as refrel3 v1 archives against one decoded reference, and decodes random training windows and coordinate slices on the device. Format: FORMAT.md; dataset: DATASET.md.
